Part I. Additional Tax on Early Distributions. Early distributions includible in income (see instructions). For Roth I R A distributions, see instructions.
2. Enter the appropriate exception number from the instructions:
2. Early distributions included on line 1 that are not subject to the additional tax (see instructions).
